description: Plugin filesystem capability — backend host-side filesystem read of canonicalized plugin dir (~/.andromeda-pulse/plugins/ per-platform-resolved + ANDROMEDA_PULSE_PLUGIN_DIR override) at chunk #47; backend-only read, no webview JavaScript exposure, no write/execute. Tauri capability JSON gates webview→backend IPC only — actual fs read is plugins::loader::discover_plugins which uses std::fs against the canonicalized boundary in the Rust backend. Identifier reserved at arch §Occupied Resources Tauri capability identifiers; widening this capability to webview/write/execute would convert the loader into an unconstrained filesystem-read primitive (security plan §Anti-Patterns §API row 7).
